links.outcome: Diagnostic and treatment-planning scores of retrieval-augmented ReasonAgent versus ungrounded GPT-4o and residents
links.effect: Treatment planning: ReasonAgent outperformed GPT-4o (β = 0.49, p = 0.01) and residents (β = 1.71, p < 0.001). GPT-4o had 90.48% low diagnostic scores in rare cases.
links.quote: While GPT-4o showed vulnerabilities in rare cases (90.48% low diagnostic scores), ReasonAgent's hybrid design mitigated errors through structured reasoning.

unlisted_practices: Modular multimodal agent architecture combining visual analysis, knowledge retrieval and diagnostic reasoning for ophthalmology

screen.reason: The study introduces and evaluates a novel multimodal AI agent architecture (ReasonAgent) combining visual analysis, retrieval, and reasoning modules against GPT-4o and clinicians on 30 real-world retrospective cases, rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
